in_sanskrit.name: Dilsad

in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dilsad एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dilsad is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'dil' meaning 'heart' and 'hast' meaning 'joy'. This name is believed to signify the one who brings joy and happiness to the heart. In Hindu mythology, Dilsad is also the name of a Yakshi, a supernatural being believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
